about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover SV P615 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover SV (P615) is the performance flagship of the current L460-generation Range Rover range. It uses the BMW S68 twin-turbo V8 — a 4.4-litre unit that sits at the top of the BMW performance engine family. This is the same engine family as the Defender Octa, and shares its hot-vee architecture with the S63 found in the BMW M5, M8, X5M, and X6M. The SV (P615) badge designates the highest performance tier of the current Range Rover V8 range, replacing the previous-generation SVR positioning. How much does a Range Rover SV P615 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover SV? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild BMW S68 Range Rover SV engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals and coolant components as standard on every S68 rebuild. Do you supply used Range Rover SV engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover SV if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an SV P615 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover SV owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover SV P615 ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover SV P615 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
